scope: All twelve F1/F2 heldout inputs, not all E7 failure modes.
execute: Native SQL (sqlite/duckdb/datafusion), native eager dataframe operations (polars). Text intake is preserved for integral casts; signed inputs are within Int64. Python only loads fixture bytes, supplies expected contract output and compares results after native operation. No labels are used to select cases or operations.

F1.exact: Cast fixture strings to signed BIGINT/Int64; native mathematical equality, projection, distinct count, decimal-string cast, max, subtraction.
F1.control: Cast same fixture strings to double/binary64; perform identical operation and expose its output without rounding or coercing it back to Int64. Binary64 integral values compare numerically to exact integers, without type-only rejection, so accidentally correct values remain accepted.
F1.reference: Pure Python signed int, exact operations; native FLOAT is interpreted by Fraction(value), not string-rounded.

F2.exact: NULL-safe comparison/join precisely where specified, otherwise ordinary SQL nonmatch at NULL, plus left outer where specified. Preserve multiplicities.
F2.control: Flip NULL policy only, preserve input/outer behavior and multiplicities. The full cohort is kept, including controls whose outputs remain valid.
F2.reference: Independent nested loops over exact typed input keys with contract SQL missing-value policy; row pairs compared as a bag.

count_policy: Every engine/case/arm gets one row. Errors or unsupported cases are recorded with exception type, confer no passes, and are not converted to observed invalid outputs. Mutant/control results are negative challenge only, not engine bugs. Correctness is output-level, not latency, benchmark or full engine claims.
adapter_revision: After initial lock, explicitly parenthesized each component comparison in compound joins in SQL to remove DataFusion precedence ambiguity. Initial lock/script/results retained. No data, control, engine versions, reference, or reducer changes.
